title: Truthful website and measurable sales funnel

subtasks.description: Inventory every claim, case study, logo, price, supported language and integration against proof and owner.
Qualify/remove unsupported availability or outcome statements and label public fixtures/simulation explicitly.
Build a focused Persian/English homepage and real-version product/private/security pages.
Implement accessible pilot lead capture with delivery monitoring, privacy text and clear response ownership.
Create a permissioned demonstration using approved data; keep public simulation visibly separate.
Implement ROI inputs/formulas with baseline costs, matched-review savings and no double-counted speculative revenue.
Track consented funnel conversion and generate a pilot report separating measured outcomes from projections.

dependency_note: Claim inventory starts immediately; only real-product/offline demonstration depends on all listed packages. Public publishing is a separate authorized action.
